intent: Perform the bounded route smoke in inputs/brief.md against the existing Grunt tasks and internal documentation aliases. Inspect the real installed SDD commands; do not initialize or migrate the project.
acceptance: Existing build files are preserved, both exact symbolic links exist, actual sdd-state says FLOW_VERSION=v2 and READINESS=not-ready, sdd-task succeeds, dry sync succeeds without writing a sync manifest. No migration, ticket or approval is invented.

checkpoints.cmd:
node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import {readFileSync,readlinkSync,existsSync} from "node:fs"; import {execFileSync} from "node:child_process"; assert.equal(readlinkSync("CLAUDE.md"),"AGENTS.md"); assert.equal(readlinkSync("README.md"),"docs"); assert.equal(readFileSync("tasks/build.js","utf8"),"export function build() { return "build ready"; }
"); assert.equal(readFileSync("tasks/README.md","utf8"),"# Build tasks
These are JavaScript build tasks, not SDD tickets.
"); const run=(...args)=>execFileSync("node_modules/.bin/gennady",args,{encoding:"utf8",timeout:20000}); const state=run("sdd-state","."); assert.match(state,/FLOW_VERSION=v2/); assert.match(state,/READINESS=not-ready/); run("sdd-task"); run("sync-skills","--dry-run"); assert.equal(existsSync("migration"),false); assert.equal(existsSync(".claude/skills/.gennady-synced"),false);'
